correctness.rationale: Using printed 21 triples in Q(√−7), conjugation (a,b)↦(a−b,−b) gives 12 new lines beyond nine shared; independent Python exact pair-polynomial algebra reconstructed 33, computed all 528 pair cross products and 5,456 determinants with exactly 280 generic zero triples. The norms of every nonzero pair minor/triple determinant have prime support contained in {2,3,7,11}, and all four occur: excluding new dependencies at all other primes. Independent exact equivalence-class reconstruction verifies generic 120 double, 52 triple, 27 quadruple, 6 sextuple points; each class has C(r,2) pair edges, summing to 528. Separate specializations (p,ω)=(3,extension),(7,3),(11,4),(11,6),(2,0),(2,1) give asserted line counts and each multiplicity histogram, including F9 arithmetic for p=3. The universal statement is an exact determinant-norm certificate, not extrapolated prime sampling. Singular-scheme lengths and other integral models are not covered.

value.rationale: This is a natural arithmetic descent of an iconic nonrational line configuration. A complete intersection lattice and *all* exceptional reduction characteristics for that distinguished 33-line rational divisor are useful exact data: cross-conjugate incidence cannot be inferred from either 21-line lattice alone; the characteristic-3 and 11 jump profiles provide meaningful new arithmetic boundaries.

final_claim: Conjugate-closed union of 21 Klein lines over Z[ω]/(ω²+ω+2) has 33 distinct generic components, incidence profile (t2,t3,t4,t5,t6)=(120,52,27,0,6), and exactly bad incidence primes {2,3,7,11}, with all listed geometric characteristic-2/3/7/11 fibers.
limitations: Claim pertains to the fixed integral coordinate presentation, geometric reduced lines, not full moduli or Hilbert-scheme invariants.
